description: Adds products to a list on the signed-in shopper's account, by list_id and Plendio product id (or product url), each with an optional note of up to 140 characters. A product already on the list stays as it is. Works on lists the shopper owns or may edit. Unknown or unavailable products are reported and not added. Requires sign-in.

note.description: Optional short note shown with the product, e.g. a size or colour. Up to 140 characters; markup and links are removed.

product_id.description: Plendio product id (the id field of a search result).

slug.description: Alternative to product_id: the product's url, or the slug-and-id at its end (acme-book-15-42). The number after the last dash is the id.

market.description: Market for the links and prices in the answer: dk, se, de or no.

name: add_to_my_wishlist
title: Add products to my list
